title: Code and data for: Tourism closures did not detectably reduce nearshore turbidity at Saint Martin's Island, Bay of Bengal: a Sentinel-2 counterfactual analysis
description:
Google Earth Engine scripts, Python scripts and derived data supporting the article Tourism closures did not detectably reduce nearshore turbidity at Saint Martin's Island, Bay of Bengal: a Sentinel-2 counterfactual analysis.

The record contains the study zones, zonal Sentinel-2 turbidity and red-reflectance time series (2017–2026), environmental predictors (ERA5, CHIRPS, GOT4.10 tides), VIIRS night-light series, modelling tables and all analysis outputs needed to reproduce the numbers, tables and figures of the article. See README.md for the workflow and instructions.
